svg.aria-label: PneumaSpace. No agent inside. Built for what agents build. A directory named notes with a manifest and src is published through the admin port in seconds with no image build and lands in the isolate lane, asleep. A visitor arrives through the gateway stages; the first wake takes 460 to 700 ms, later wakes 62 to 87 ms. Its db, kv, object and ws edges light up; when idle it goes dark while its data stays. A container app wakes in about 260 ms and a static site is served with nothing woken. The chat worker hangs, turns red, is stopped 3.5 to 4 s after the stuck request and quarantined by the Guard while survey and ttt keep answering; release 2 replaces it, and the host is calm again.
svg.title: PneumaSpace
svg.text: No agent inside. Built for what agents build.
Publish a directory. It wakes on demand, sleeps when idle and keeps its data.

g.text: a directory: a manifest and src/
publish: one bundle, no image build
first wake 460–700 ms, bundle unpacked once
awake: db, kv, object and ws mounted
idle, so asleep; its data stays
a container wakes in about 260 ms
a busy loop holds its worker
stopped 3.5–4 s after the stuck request
calm again: nothing awake, all data kept
